subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Read about rainforests and find causes and effects.
Make a plan with arrows for a text.
Present the causes and effects of a problem.

tf.s: Rainforests have more plants and animals than any other habitat.
tf.why: Yes, that is why they are so important.

tf.s: Trees are used to make fuel, paper and furniture.
Forest workers burn trees so farmers can have new land.
tf.why: Right, for crops and farm animals.

tf.s: Burning trees makes the air cleaner.
tf.why: Burning trees makes gases that cause air pollution.

tf.s: When rainforest trees are cut down, plants die and animals move away.
tf.why: Well done, that is the chain of effects.
It is an effect of cutting down trees.
Yes, the gases cause global warming.

tf.s: Melting ice helps penguins and polar bears.
tf.why: Melting ice makes them lose some of their habitats.

tf.s: A plan with arrows can show causes and effects.
tf.why: Good, arrows link cause to effect.

tf.s: Cutting down rainforests is not a problem for animals.
tf.why: Animals lose their habitat and move away.

mcq.q: Which of these is a cause, not an effect, in the rainforest text?
mcq.why: Cutting trees is the cause; the others are effects.

mcq.q: Which things are made from trees?
mcq.why: Trees give fuel, oil, paper, furniture and wooden homes.

mcq.q: What happens when rainforest trees are burned?
o: They make gases that cause air pollution and global warming.

mcq.q: Why do forest workers sometimes burn the trees?
o: so farmers can have new land for crops and farm animals
mcq.why: The land is used for farming.

mcq.q: Make an arrow plan: trees are cut down → ...
mcq.why: Cutting trees causes plants to die and animals to leave.

mcq.q: Which sentence shows cause and effect correctly?
o: Because of burning trees, there is more air pollution.
Because of air pollution, people burn trees.
Air pollution causes trees to burn.
mcq.why: Burning trees is the cause; pollution is the effect.

mcq.q: For the plastic rubbish presentation, which is a cause-and-effect plan?
o: plastic in the sea → sea animals are hurt
plastic is a word → it has seven letters
plastic is blue → it is nice
mcq.why: A clear cause leads to an effect.

mcq.q: Ice in the Arctic and Antarctic is melting. What is the effect?
o: Penguins and polar bears lose some of their habitats.
mcq.why: Melting ice takes away their habitat.

mcq.q: 'Animals lose habitat.' Why is this an effect, not a cause?
o: It happens because trees are cut down.
It happens before trees are cut.
It is a kind of fuel.
mcq.why: It is the result of cutting down the rainforest.

mcq.q: Farmers get new land, but animals lose their homes. What does this show?
o: One action can have good and bad effects.
mcq.why: Burning forests helps farming but harms animals and the air.
